enemies.name: OpFor: Armor
enemies.flavour_text: Steam armor thoroughly corrupted by Originium, an OpFor unit based on the scenario of a Terra-wide Originium disaster. As Originium spreads, courage, resolve and glory are turned to crystalline dust, leaving behind the armor, torn apart by crystals to march towards the fading light of the sunset.

abilities.text: Randomly selects a target and fires in a line, dealing Arts damage

[Woe of Extinction] Fires an <Armor Piercer> at the Operator with the highest ATK, which explodes when it reaches the target, stunning them and units in the 8 surrounding tiles for an extended time and causing them to take Physical damage every second; <Armor Piercer> can be destroyed by attacking it several times when it is flying
When HP drops below a certain percentage, Physical and Arts damage taken is reduced, and [Woe of Extinction] fires additional <Armor Piercer>
[Deathswarm] Periodically summons drones
Hidden Core

[Sword and Hammer of Olden Days] When specific conditions are met and the simulation enters the Hidden Core round, <OpFor: Armor> will appear in its final form and gain 'Armor Cleaver' and 'Armor Crusher'
'Armor Cleaver' and 'Armor Crusher' start Invulnerable; When shot down, transfer a percentage of the damage taken to OpFor: Armor

'Armor Cleaver' and 'Armor Crusher' periodically fly towards the Operator with the lowest ATK and explode, stunning the target and Operators in the 8 surrounding tiles, and dealing Physical damage every second before returning to OpFor: Armor; they lose Invulnerable status when flying and will fall to the ground after taking a certain number of hits; when on ground, they are treated as low ground units and take more damage

enemies.name: OpFor: Gun
enemies.flavour_text: Holy Gun-Knight corrupted and reshaped by Originium, an OpFor unit based on the scenario of a Terra-wide Originium disaster. As Originium spreads, it seizes everything we revere and takes its place. It will be the new order when all others are shattered.

abilities.text: Attacks prioritize units with the highest DEF
Attacks inflict Corrosion
Cannot be blocked.
ASPD gradually increases when attacking the same enemy repeatedly
[Final Judgment] Stops attacking and gains greatly increased Movement Speed, charging at the unit with the highest DEF and dealing Physical damage to units it passes by
Hidden Core

[Unending Confession] After fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round in the simulation, <'Gunshatter'> appears on the field, and Physical and Arts damage taken by <OpFor: Gun> is significantly reduced

[Blind Faith] Connects to all <'Gunshatters'> on the field; a percentage of damage taken by <'Gunshatters'> is transferred to <OpFor: Gun>, and allied units on the [Blind Faith] link take Physical damage every second
[Doomsaying] Continuously calls all <'Gunshatters'> towards it; <'Gunshatters'> gain greatly increased Movement Speed, become immune to damage, and deal damage to allied units that they pass by

enemies.name: OpFor: Pipe
enemies.flavour_text: The 'Empresses' Voice' recreated by Originium, an OpFor unit based on the scenario of a Terra-wide Originium disaster. As Originium spreads, it overcomes all praise and reproach, the echoes upon its surface merely another name for Originium.

abilities.text: When on the field, continuously summons <'Echoes'> in [Penumbral Lament] form; summon interval reduces when HP drops below a certain point
Attacks prioritize <'Echoes'> in [Penumbral Lament] form
[Cracked Pipe] Attacks all <'Echoes'> in [Penumbral Lament] form three times in a row, dealing AoE Arts damage and inflicting Necrosis
Hidden Core
<OpFor: String> and <OpFor: Pipe> will appear at the same time after fulfilling specific conditions and entering the Hidden Core round

enemies.name: 'Samivilinn,' the Resolution of the Very North
enemies.icon: /enemies-icons/'Samivilinn,' the Resolution of the Very North.webp
enemies.flavour_text: Born from a memory of the soil, stone, ice, and snow, it stands tall, blocking the path of every living being until satisfied.

abilities.text: [Icicle Fall] Attacks deal Physical damage to allied units in a column
[Surge of Nature] Inflicts Stun on an allied unit and causes the target to take Arts damage over time
After falling below half HP, takes reduced Physical and Arts damage and [Icicle Fall] and [Surge of Nature] both target an additional unit
After a long time has passed in the battle, deals Arts damage to all allied units on the field and drains 30 Life Points

enemies.name: Alistair, Final Flame of the Empire
enemies.flavour_text: The final flame of the empire, a specter adorned with a rusted crown. Refute him. Refute Victoria's supreme glory and authority. He will examine the evidence. He may yet forgive.

abilities.text: When HP drops below half, DEF and RES increase, and [Imperial Domain] activates two pieces of gear
[Expulsion] After some time has passed, deals Arts splash damage to all your units, and drains all Life Points
[Royal Decree] Locks onto an allied unit and their surrounding 4 tiles, dealing heavy Physical damage to targets within that range once and generating random gear on tiles within that range
[Imperial Domain] Activates a piece of gear on the field; different types of gear will result in different effects

enemies.name: Lucian, 'Blood Diamond'
enemies.flavour_text: Calamity of the Crimson Troupe, codename Phantom. Once the rising star of the troupe, the unfinished masterpiece of the troupe leader. Even after his fallout with the troupe and subsequent descent into insanity, he still keeps the name 'Blood Diamond'.

abilities.text: Has a chance to dodge Physical and Arts attacks when not blocked. When blocked, swiftly moves behind the target and leaves an <Ominous Apparition> at the original location
Can use skills to deal Physical damage to the surrounding area; attacks and skills ignore a certain amount of DEF and inflict Nervous Impairment

enemies.name: Sal Viento Bishop Quintus
enemies.flavour_text: A member of the Church of the Deep who snuck into disaster-ravaged Iberia. He changed the law of the land through his sincere beliefs, in pursuit of the perfect form, yet he was unable to fathom the will of the ocean. Then again, who could?

abilities.text: Attacks two units with the highest DEF simultaneously
[Great Tide] Deals Arts damage and Nervous Impairment to all allied units
[Collapse] Deals Physical damage to multiple allied units
[Fragmentation] Summons its offspring to entwine themselves around allied units and Stun them
[Species Outbreak] Drains all Life Points after a long time has passed in the battle

enemies.name: Frost
enemies.flavour_text: An unmanned enemy drone equipped with heavy armor to make it harder to destroy. Its prototype was designed by a graphics engine studio. They are equipped with a special device that allows them to drastically reduce the temperature around them, greatly decreasing the attack speed of nearby Operators.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
All friendly units within range have reduced ASPD

enemies.name: Sudaram
enemies.flavour_text: The Sudaram is the shroud of the dead. Once gaunt from hunger, it is now nourished by the power of the Nachzehrer King. For the Nachzehrer, consumption and nourishment—greed and devotion—are just two sides of the same dreaded coin.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding units.
When inside Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, attacks deal Physical damage to all surrounding allied units and all your units inside Originium pollution or Active Originium Storms.

enemies.name: Profane Chimera
enemies.flavour_text: A twisted creation of the Confessarii, this bio-weapon combines multiple pure Sarkaz bloodlines. Originium dust clings to its body, spreading as it flaps its great wings while moving.

abilities.text: Continuously causes an area of Originium pollution around itself when affected by Originium pollution or an Active Originium Storm, and attacks deal Arts damage instead.

enemies.name: Bombtail
enemies.flavour_text: An unmanned enemy drone that flies slowly. They carry an explosive warhead that is launched when approaching nearby Operators, inflicting physical damage in an area. Their design seems to have been inspired by a fantasy creature. Though they cannot attack anymore after launching the warhead, their movement speed increases afterwards due to the loss of weight.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Can launch a warhead to deal AoE physical damage
Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after launching warhead

enemies.name: Heavy Defender Leader
enemies.flavour_text: One of Reunion's melee soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Heavy Defender. Equipped with a full set of heavy armor, they have ample combat experience and are extremely hard to defeat. As they may have had formal training, proceed with caution.

enemies.name: Multicellular Herald
enemies.flavour_text: Highly differentiated Seaborn with specialized tentacles that have proliferated across the ocean. Numbering in the billions, they are believed to shape ocean currents when they wave their tentacles.

abilities.text: Can devour an Excrescent Carapace to significantly increase its ATK and HP.

enemies.name: 'Armor of the Empire'
enemies.flavour_text: Royal Guards who swore an oath of eternal loyalty to Victoria. In the King's memories, their steel bodies lined up to form mountains, and white steam covered the sky above.

abilities.text: Locks onto an allied unit with the current highest HP, dealing Physical damage multiple times to it and the nearby unit with the current highest HP
Can perform long-ranged attacks
After several attacks, charges up for an attack that deals heavy damage 3 times

enemies.name: Guerrilla Shieldguard
enemies.flavour_text: One of Patriot's elite defenders. Carrying out Patriot's will, these shieldguards form the solid foundation of the 'Aegis of the Infected.' Equipped with high-performance protective armor, they cover for their comrades by drawing fire from enemies while present on the battlefield.

abilities.text: More likely to be targeted by attacks.

enemies.name: Derisive Audience
enemies.flavour_text: A diehard fan of the Crimson Troupe, they enjoy the performances night and day. They have become as incomprehensible as the troupe itself.

abilities.text: Attacks inflict additional Nervous Impairment

enemies.name: 'Pride of the Sankta'
enemies.flavour_text: Haloed aquatic creature that the Law has determined to be Sankta. They have learned to pray, and they invite the slothful to pray with them. They will not take 'no' for an answer.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Gains Fear for several seconds when its HP drops below 50% for the first time
[Invitation to Prayer] Temporarily reduces all your units' ASPD

enemies.name: Chalice of Regret
enemies.flavour_text: Soul chalice born of a revenant's will, brimming with regret unfathomable. The past, tormenting yet unchangeable, is the cruelest cut.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
Shares a fraction of the damage taken by non-aerial enemies around itself.

enemies.name: Magnificence
enemies.flavour_text: A Waregeist that manifested when it was infected by Sui-Xiang. Its tiny glimmer serves as a beacon casting light upon the dark night. A Waregeist of this type not only blesses its peers with its radiance, but is also particularly destructive.

abilities.text: Periodically grants temporary Invisibility to surrounding enemy units
Spawns 1 <Iron Lampstand> when defeated

enemies.name: OpFor: Quagmire
enemies.flavour_text: OpFor unit designed to emulate the liquid form of Originium. No one knows why it began to take such form, but it may be the precursor to another Originium disaster. Through simulation, we will find a way to destroy it, control it, or utilize it.

abilities.text: Less likely to be attacked
When blocked, plants itself on the blocker, causing them to take continuous Arts damage and increased Elemental Injury
When an Elemental Injury burst occurs on the parasitized target, inflicts a large amount of Elemental Injury of the same type on other allied units in the four adjacent tiles

enemies.name: OpFor: Rebirth
enemies.flavour_text: OpFor unit designed to emulate monsters born from Originium. We have fought such foes on the Rhodes Island landship, adversaries that regenerate, rise again, and kill wearing the form of the fallen. Study ways to counter them through simulation.

abilities.text: When defeated, enters a revival state and gives other enemies within range a shield that protects against Physical and Arts damage, which is broken after taking a certain number of attacks
In the revival state, it needs to be damaged multiple times to be knocked down, and revives after some time

enemies.name: Scarlet Singer
enemies.flavour_text: A performer of the Crimson Troupe, they unleash their singing voices when sufficiently stimulated, inciting their followers to attack in a frenzy.

abilities.text: Attacks inflict additional Nervous Impairment
After receiving a certain number of hits, greatly increases all enemies' ASPD for a short period

enemies.name: Burning Vine
enemies.flavour_text: Passionate fae, the fire in its heart like a torch under a strange arch. The flowers and vines wrapping around it are merely decorative.

abilities.text: Attacks inflict additional Burn
ATK continuously increases before its first attack, and the first attack deals a large amount of Arts damage and Burn to the target and surrounding units
Continuously attacks, dealing AoE Physical damage
Starts Invulnerable; When shot down, transfers a percentage of the damage taken to OpFor: Armor
Periodically flies towards the Operator with the lowest ATK, stunning the target and Operators in the 8 surrounding tiles, and dealing Physical damage every second
Flying 'Armor Cleaver' is shot down after taking a certain number of attacks
'Armor Cleaver' becomes a low ground unit and takes more damage when shot down
Continuously attacks, dealing AoE Physical damage
Starts Invulnerable; When shot down, transfers a percentage of the damage taken to OpFor: Armor
Periodically flies towards the Operator with the lowest ATK, stunning the target and Operators in the 8 surrounding tiles, and dealing Physical damage every second
Flying 'Armor Crusher' is shot down after taking a certain number of attacks
'Armor Crusher' becomes a low ground unit and takes more damage when shot down

enemies.name: 'Gunshatter'
enemies.flavour_text: Confessional corrupted and reshaped by Originium. It will be the Holy Gun-Knight's bullet, carrying out its will faithfully, regardless of the nature of the will.

abilities.text: [Unfinished Prayer] Starts with one of the following special shields; cannot be blocked while the shield is active; regains the shield a certain period after it disappears

Elemental Shield: Physical and Arts damage taken greatly reduced; shield disappears when Elemental Injury burst occurs. When this shield is active, periodically fires a projectile that inflicts Elemental Injury and ricochets several times, reducing damage with each bounce

Arts Shield: Gains a certain amount of Arts Barrier, greatly reduces Physical damage taken while active. If Physical damage is taken when shield is active, deals Physical damage to and inflicts Corrosion on the source.
Modulated Shield: Disappears after taking damage several times. Periodically performs a 10-combo attack when shield is active.

enemies.name: OpFor: String
enemies.flavour_text: The 'Witch King's Voice' recreated by Originium, an OpFor unit based on the scenario of a Terra-wide Originium disaster. Originium retrieves a shadow from the boundless ocean, giving it a new body and voice. The silent sea encompasses all, except for that future the shadow caught a glimpse of in the Pavillon.

abilities.text: Permanently Invulnerable; leaves the field when <OpFor: Pipe> is defeated
When on the field, continuously summons <'Echoes'> in [Golden Wail] form
Attacks prioritize <'Echoes'> in [Golden Wail] form

[Broken Strings] Targets all <'Echoes'> in [Golden Wail] form on the field, dealing Arts damage in a large area centered around them and inflicting Necrosis, and transforms the targets' <'Echoes'> form

enemies.name: Yan's Protection
enemies.flavour_text: The creations of Yanese Tianshis allow ordinary wood and iron to take to the skies through fire, and scatter as a firmament of sparks to protect the land and its people. They are beacons of joy in times of peace, and powerful weapons in times of war.

abilities.text: At the start of battle, Yan's Protection gains ATK and HP equal to a percentage of the total ATK and HP of all Yan Alliance Operators on the field
Attacks multiple targets, inflicting a percentage of ATK as Burn; nearby enemy units gain a certain percentage of Elemental Fragility
[Cleansing Flame] Continuously shoots fires at an enemy in attack range, dealing Arts damage equal to a percentage of ATK every second, and dealing damage to several enemies around the target

enemies.name: Sarkaz Wither Vanguard
enemies.flavour_text: Elites of the Nachzehrer King's armies, adept in Originium-rich environments. They draw power from Originium dust and fight until death claims them as nutrients for their comrades.

abilities.text: Attacks deal Arts damage when inside Originium pollution.

enemies.name: Monster
enemies.flavour_text: An unmanned enemy drone, called 'Monster' by Reunion forces. Equipped with a long-range Arts receiver, they are likely operated by concealed Casters. Though unlikely to cause heavy damage to armored Operators, they can still pose a considerable threat.

abilities.text: Flying unit.

enemies.name: Hound Pro
enemies.flavour_text: A creature controlled by a Reunion recon squad that is more dangerous than a normal Hound. Monitoring equipment is strapped to its body. Due to their speed and evasiveness, they can easily slip through enemy defenses and cause heavy damage.

enemies.name: Infused Glacial Originium Slug
enemies.flavour_text: An infected wild creature native to colder environments that has become unstable due to assimilating a large amount of Originium into its abdomen. Upon death, they will explode and freeze nearby Operators. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by Yeti Squadron members for various tactical purposes.

abilities.text: Upon death, deals Physical damage in an area and applies Cold to affected targets

enemies.name: Originium Slug
enemies.flavour_text: An infected wild creature. Due to their low intelligence, they are easily controlled by enemy casters for use as cannon fodder during invasions.

enemies.name: Arts Master A1
enemies.flavour_text: An unmanned enemy drone with extremely high movement speed, modified from the product of an Arts Education competition. It is equipped with an Arts Weapon module that allows it to launch long-range Arts attacks, so proceed with caution. Based on available data, its weapon module also allows it to block some Arts damage.

abilities.text: Flying unit.

enemies.name: 'Echoes'
enemies.flavour_text: A lingering beat, a dull echo. Who conducts it, and why does it sing?

abilities.text: Must be attacked several times to defeat
Can only be blocked by units with at least 2 Block
[Polytonality]: Switches between [Golden Wail] and [Penumbral Lament] forms
ASPD increased in [Golden Wail] form, transforms into [Penumbral Lament] form after taking damage several times
Movement Speed is reduced while ATK is increased in [Penumbral Lament] form, transforms into [Golden Wail] form after taking damage several times
Upon taking damage, deals Arts damage in an area around itself, inflicting Necrosis
All <'Echoes'> periodically play in ensemble, dealing AoE Arts damage and inflicting Necrosis

enemies.name: Wraith Leader
enemies.flavour_text: One of Reunion's engineers. Due to being better trained and more heavily equipped, they are harder to neutralize in time, even if they have been detected. They utilize their agility and cunning to slip through defenses in order to sabotage mechanical and electrical equipment.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked.

enemies.name: Monster Mk II
enemies.flavour_text: An unmanned enemy drone that has been upgraded from its namesake model, the Monster MkII. Equipped with a small gun and a long-range Arts receiver, they are likely operated by concealed Casters. Though unlikely to cause heavy damage to armored Operators, they can still pose a considerable threat.

abilities.text: Flying unit.
